newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Three die as Russian barracks collapse - agency.
newsitem.headline: Three die as Russian barracks collapse - agency.

text.p: Three people died and at least 41 were injured on Thursday when ceilings collapsed in a three-storey dormitory at a military school in western Siberia, Interfax news agency reported.

It quoted the Emergencies Ministry as saying about 120 people were in the building when the roofs caved in and that a special investigation team headed by its minister, Sergei Shoigu, had set off for the site, at Tomsk.
The chairman of Tomsk regional assembly, Boris Maltsev, told Interfax between eight and 10 people were trapped between floors.
"At least three of them are alive and are answering rescuers' questions," he was quoted as saying. He said the building had once been a monastery and was converted to a dormitory in the early 1950s.
